nodes.label: Chrono_pardisomkl library target
nodes.rationale: Wraps Intel oneMKL PARDISO behind ChSolverPardisoMKL; the MKL_ARCH/LINK/THREADING/INTERFACE/MPI cache variables are pre-seeded and marked advanced so users get working defaults (intel64, dynamic, intel_thread, lp64) without reading the oneMKL CMake docs. Also defines EIGEN_USE_MKL_ALL so Eigen routes through MKL.
